_about: Reference routing for the Scope 3 mock inbox (components/inbox_router/data/mock_inbox.json), written and committed BEFORE either system was run. Labels follow the system's own outcome definitions (components/inbox_router/llm_classifier.py): reply = the user should reply directly; forward = forward to someone else; schedule = about a meeting, appointment or deadline that belongs on a calendar; cold_email = unsolicited outreach from someone with no prior relationship; leave_alone = no action needed. 'primary' is the single best outcome; 'acceptable' adds outcomes a reasonable person could also choose for a genuinely ambiguous message. Assigned by an AI annotator (Claude) from the message text alone, blind to both systems' outputs; not an independent human validation. mock-101..105 are excluded: they are the user's already-answered history from which both systems learn.
